title: Unintended Duplicate Routes and Double Prefix in OpenAPI Schema
location: FastAPI router aggregation in main.py and system.py
description: OpenAPI schema exposes 44 endpoints instead of 32 due to duplicate routes with double prefix /api/v1/api/v1/system/status, /api/v1/api/v1/system/capabilities, and alias /api/v1/health.
evidence: GET /api/v1/api/v1/system/status and GET /api/v1/system/status both return 200 with identical payloads. App openapi paths count is 43.
impact: Swagger documentation exhibits duplicate paths; client SDK generators create redundant methods.
recommended_correction: Strip /api/v1 from route decorators inside system.py (/status, /capabilities); mount system_router exclusively in api_v1_router; bind /health as standalone root route in main.py.

title: Missing Root Dependency Manifest (pyproject.toml / requirements.txt)
description: No pinned requirements.txt or pyproject.toml exists in the repository root.
evidence: find . -name requirements*.txt -o -name pyproject.toml returns empty. Pytest uses global Python environment.
impact: Impedes automated virtualenv reproduction and deterministic dependency locking for independent external reviewers.
recommended_correction: Create root requirements.txt and pyproject.toml pinning exact tested versions (fastapi==0.142.2, gdal==3.13.3, numpy==2.4.6, etc.).

title: Hardcoded Regional Identifier in Vector Asset Response Wrapper
description: VectorAssetResponse hardcodes region_id="jamuna_sirajganj" rather than querying VECTOR_CATALOG.
evidence: L29: region_id="jamuna_sirajganj". If assets from another region are served, response schema will misreport region.
impact: Breaks multi-region schema consistency for future non-Jamuna vector assets.
recommended_correction: Read region_id directly from VECTOR_CATALOG lookup metadata.

title: Hardcoded Projected CRS in Raster Metadata Service
description: Metadata dictionary hardcodes crs="EPSG:32645" instead of querying dataset spatial reference.
evidence: L274: "crs": "EPSG:32645". If a raster in WGS84 or UTM Zone 46N is queried, EPSG:32645 is returned.
impact: Geospatial clients may misinterpret the CRS of non-Zone 45N datasets.
recommended_correction: Query ds.GetSpatialRef().GetName() or parse EPSG code from projection WKT.

title: Large Synchronous GeoJSON Payloads in Vector Endpoints
description: Vector endpoints serve multi-megabyte uncompressed GeoJSON responses (newly_inundated_candidate is 4.29 MB with 6,725 features).
evidence: Vector newly_inundated_candidate: size=4291.4 KB, latency=76.67 ms. phase5_inundation_clusters: size=1982.3 KB.
impact: High network transfer time and frontend browser DOM freezing if rendered directly without vector tiling or polygon simplification.
recommended_correction: Enable GZipMiddleware in FastAPI, pre-simplify geometries for preview zoom levels, or adopt Vector Tiles (MVT) in Phase 9.

title: Synchronous Job Execution and Absence of Job Cancellation Endpoint
description: Jobs execute synchronously on submission, bypassing PENDING state; no endpoint exists to cancel running jobs.
evidence: INSERT into jobs sets RUNNING immediately; execution finishes before HTTP 201 is returned. Database supports CANCELLED but no cancel API exists.
impact: Acceptable for current demonstration; however, long-running heavy audits cannot be cancelled mid-flight.
recommended_correction: Implement background task dispatching (asyncio / BackgroundTasks) and add POST /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/cancel endpoint.

title: Matplotlib Default Cache Directory Non-Writable in Standalone Scripts
description: Matplotlib attempts to write cache to /home/orr/.config/matplotlib, producing warning on stderr.
evidence: Running scripts emits: Matplotlib created a temporary cache directory at /tmp/matplotlib-...
impact: Non-fatal warning noise on stderr during CLI execution. Backend has mitigated this via os.environ.setdefault in config.py.
recommended_correction: Export MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl_cache in shell environment or add to scripts/__init__.py.

title: Dual Historical Riverbank Transect Count Baselines (134 vs 122 Valid)
description: Phase 6 initially reported 134 valid transects, while Phase 6.1 audited geometry reduced valid count to 122 (53 ambiguous).
evidence: Phase 6.1 Table 2 audits 12 complex braid-bar intersections reclassified as ambiguous char splits.
impact: Potential reviewer confusion if Phase 6.0 initial report is read without Phase 6.1 reconciliation.
recommended_correction: Backend correctly serves authoritative 122 valid / 53 ambiguous count; documented in errata report.
